subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “She said language is not only for tests.”?
options: When something becomes part of daily life, people stop seeing its value.
The teacher answered, "Seeing was never enough.
Students learned that fire changed human life.
It carries ways of seeing life.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「When something becomes part of daily life, people stop seeing its value.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher answered, 'Seeing was never enough.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students learned that fire changed human life.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「She said language is not only for tests. It carries ways of seeing life.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
